# TellQA

> > A community-driven Q&A platform where users share questions, stories, and knowledge on diverse topics ranging from local news and genealogy to personal finance and lifestyle advice.

TellQA features user-generated content covering regional stories (Santa Barbara County, Charleston, Charlotte), financial services (TIAA retirement planning, 401(k)s, IRAs), consumer topics (Lowes, U-Haul, Dunkin'), and community knowledge sharing. The platform emphasizes open discussion with its tagline 'Ask Freely, Answer Boldly.'

## Key Topics

- Community Q&A Platform
- Knowledge Sharing
- User-Generated Content
- TIAA Retirement Planning
- 401(k) and IRA Accounts
- Local News Coverage
- Regional Stories (Charlotte, Charleston, Santa Barbara)
- Genealogy and Family History
- Consumer Services (Lowes, U-Haul, Dunkin')
- Financial Security
- Funeral Services
- Kentucky Culture and History
- Home Improvement
- Personal Finance
